doc: Turn 2 tools (OpenAPI function objects). Kotlin: litertlm tool(OpenApiTool) with this object as the description; Python: Tool.get_tool_description() wraps it as {type: function, function: <this>}. Arguments are validated in code against these enums; anything else is ignored.

tools.name: request_auto_context
tools.description: Ask the user for consent to read the message that contained the link and a few messages around it in the source app.

tools.name: request_user_context
tools.description: Ask the user one fixed question (U1-U4) and let them answer with quick choices or text.

question_id.description: U1 how did you get this link; U2 what were you about to do; U3 did a call or message tell you to open it; U4 were you in a used-goods trade

tools.name: no_context_needed
tools.description: How the user got this link would not change the risk.
